info.name: CollabDocs API
info.description: All 17 CollabDocs endpoints, in the order they run end to end (users -> workspace -> documents -> comments -> tags -> audit logs). Start the server, then run the collection top to bottom. Error cases (400 / 404 / 409) sit next to the request they exercise. The rollback demo needs DJANGO_DEBUG=True.

item.name: Create user - invalid email and phone (400)

request.description: Creates the workspace and adds the owner as an admin member in one transaction.atomic() block.

exec: pm.test("Owner counted as the first member", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().member_count).to.eql(1));

request.description: Hits the unique_workspace_member constraint; the IntegrityError is turned into 409.

item.name: List members - only editors and viewers

request.description: Document, member and comment totals from one aggregate() query.
Saves the document and DocumentVersion 1 in one transaction; the post_save signal writes the AuditLog.
Needs DJANGO_DEBUG=True. Fails AFTER the document, its version and its audit log are written. Afterwards GET /documents/ and GET /audit-logs/ show nothing was kept.

body.raw:
{
  "title": "Doomed document",
  "content": "This must not be saved",
  "workspace": "{{workspace_id}}",
  "created_by": "{{user_id}}",
  "simulate_failure": true
}

item.name: List documents - filter by workspace, status and search

exec: pm.test("Versions are in order", () => { const n = pm.response.json().map(v => v.version_number); pm.expect(n).to.eql([...n].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

request.description: Version, comment and contributor counts (contributors = distinct users who saved a version).
Accepts tag names and/or tag IDs. Unknown tags return 404.

exec: // Make sure the tag exists (a 409 here just means it already does).
pm.test("Replies are nested under their parent", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json()[0].replies.length).to.be.above(0));
